baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated predicates join following the Book to maintaining prayer and spending.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Book is written discourse with binding force, and following it proceeds into two maintained practices. The verse therefore presents recitation as enacted adherence rather than vocal performance alone.

activation_trace.role: Following one thing after another supplies the passage from received wording into successive acts.
Ordered letters and the written object keep an actual recited text at the center of the mechanism.
A writing that fixes an obligation makes the text directive rather than merely informative.
Care, preservation, and continual attendance make prayer a maintained institution.
The concrete exit of wealth turns adherence outward into material practice.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists people who recite scripture, pray, and give.
changed_reading.after: The verse depicts people who keep following a binding writing by sustaining prayer and sending provision into practice.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired adverbials 'secretly and openly' qualify the same act of spending before trade is named.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hidden and manifest giving jointly cover the full visibility range. Read beside the Book as an enrolling record, the pair relocates valuation away from audience reaction: the same account remains active whether no observer sees it or everyone does.

activation_trace.role: Concealment in the interior supplies the transaction's unobserved register.
Manifest disclosure supplies the public register without changing the underlying act.
Enrollment in a register supplies an audit image that is not dependent on human spectators.
Profit-seeking exchange gives the two visibility states one shared account.

changed_reading.before: Secret and public are two acceptable donation styles.
changed_reading.after: Secret and public spending form total audit coverage, making the hoped-for return independent of reputation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots of establishing, spending, trade, and perishing carry an internal market sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: One focus branch lets a market stand and flourish, another lets wealth go out and a sale move, and the closing verb names stagnation that decays value. Prayer and expenditure can therefore be read as the stabilizing and circulating motions of a market that does not seize up.

activation_trace.role: A market rising into active demand makes establishment an economic condition as well as a ritual verb.
Going out, depletion, and marketability supply the risky outward movement that keeps value circulating.
Trade seeking profit names the coordinated practices as an exchange process.
Market stagnation progressing to spoilage defines the failure that the final negation excludes.

changed_reading.before: Trade is a decorative metaphor for accumulating merit.
changed_reading.after: The verse models worship and giving as stabilization plus circulation, the two motions that prevent a moral economy from stagnating.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Hope directly governs a trade whose ruin is categorically denied.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hope carries both anticipated good and temporal postponement. The trade is thus inventory committed now while settlement remains later; the guarantee concerns preservation across the delay rather than immediate visible profit.

activation_trace.role: The heart's orientation toward an expected good supplies positive expectation.
Deferral to a later time supplies the settlement horizon carried inside that expectation.
Profit-seeking exchange supplies the committed inventory awaiting return.
Ruin and invalidation define what cannot overtake the account during delay.

changed_reading.before: Hope means confidence that good deeds are profitable.
changed_reading.after: Hope is the temporal discipline of committing value now while trusting that delayed inventory will neither expire nor be invalidated.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The spending is explicitly from only part of what 'We provided them' before it is called trade.
baseline_models.mechanism: The traders do not originate their capital. An allotted gift enters their possession, part exits through spending, and that turnover becomes the trade; non-perishing return is therefore attached to recirculating entrusted supply rather than hoarding self-owned wealth.

activation_trace.role: An apportioned gift supplies capital that precedes and exceeds the recipient's agency.
Wealth leaving its holder converts received allocation into outgoing benefit.
Exchange for gain turns the received-and-released sequence into capital turnover.
The excluded market failure marks recirculation, not possession, as the durable use of provision.

changed_reading.before: Believers invest their own goods with God.
changed_reading.after: Recipients turn over part of already allotted capital, so the trade is stewardship and recirculation rather than leverage over the giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier open-versus-hold polarity turns provision into a controlled flow. Human spending is a downstream outlet of what has first been opened and supplied, so its durability rests on source and circulation rather than the spender's stockpile.

activation_trace.role: The allotted gift anchors the focus action in capital received before it is released.
Outgoing wealth supplies the human outlet in the flow.
An opened closure and widened entrance supplies the upstream release.
Holding and confinement supply the counterfactual interruption of that release.
Provision imaged as descending rain gives the flow a sky-to-earth supply path.

structural_cues: 35:2 opposes opening with holding, 35:3 locates provision between sky and earth, and 35:29 spends only from what was provided.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, restraint, and descending provision; I infer a conduit from divine opening through human expenditure. A live alternative is the narrower claim that these cues establish dependence without a circulation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Spending reduces an individual's privately held store.
changed_reading.after: Spending opens a downstream outlet in a provision-flow whose source lies before the spender, so outflow need not equal terminal loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The expected return is calibrated by a true promise and contrasted with attractive value that does not hold. Hope in the focus is therefore not speculative optimism; it is refusal to price the trade by the glitter and uncertainty of the nearer life.

activation_trace.role: Expectation of desired good supplies the focus's forward valuation.
Profit-oriented exchange makes the basis of valuation consequential.
A spoken promise that opens expectation supplies the warrant for hope.
Stable correspondence with reality makes that warrant non-counterfeit.
A glittering surface that fails to remain supplies the rival pricing signal.
Ignorance of outcome supplies the risk profile rejected by the guaranteed trade.

structural_cues: 35:5 places the truth of the promise before a doubled warning against being deceived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies true promise versus unstable appearance; I infer that these are competing valuation regimes for the focus trade. A live alternative reads 35:5 as general warning with no special commercial force in 35:29.

changed_reading.before: The traders simply feel optimistic about reward.
changed_reading.after: Their hope is disciplined valuation grounded in a verified promise and deliberately insulated from deceptive short-term signals.

context_deltas.mechanism: An action can be cosmetically valued and misseen as good, while another apparently strategic portfolio ends in ruin. The focus criteria therefore do not guarantee every religiously branded investment; following the Book, maintained prayer, and outward provision function as tests against self-issued valuation.

activation_trace.role: A binding standard supplies an external measure for the claimed portfolio.
Skill in finding gain makes mistaken self-assessment a live commercial danger.
Applied beautification supplies cosmetic value that can cover the deed's actual quality.
Being seen by people supplies the reputational market in which appearance can be mistaken for worth.
Goodness opposed to ugliness supplies the falsely assigned grade.
The actual ruin of a scheming program supplies the failed comparison portfolio.

structural_cues: 35:8 distinguishes perceived goodness from an action's real quality; 35:10 closes the schemers' sequence with the same ruin root negated in 35:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mispricing of action and a program that perishes; I infer that the focus predicates operate as anti-counterfeit criteria. A live alternative keeps the two groups wholly external to one another and does not turn the focus inward as an audit.

changed_reading.before: Calling pious deeds a trade guarantees their value.
changed_reading.after: The trade must survive an audit against cosmetic goodness and reputation; only the text-practice-outflow configuration receives the non-ruin claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wind stirs, cloud is driven, dead land revives, dry growth opens again, and fruit appears. Because the focus provision can itself be rain, spending reads as ecological reinvestment: received life is released into another cycle, and non-perishing names regenerative yield rather than a static balance.

activation_trace.role: Rain named as provision lets the focus capital enter a water-and-growth cycle.
The release of held wealth supplies the reinvestment step.
Emergence and spreading supply the first activation of dormant material.
Driving a thing onward supplies directed transfer rather than passive possession.
Earth restored by rain supplies regenerative return after apparent depletion.
Dry pasture reopened by rain supplies a concrete image of value returning after dormancy.
Fruit as realized benefit supplies the cycle's usable yield.

structural_cues: 35:9 explicitly sequences wind, cloud, movement, rain, dead land, and renewed life; 35:27 repeats descent of water followed by varied fruits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a regenerative material chain and the focus supplies provision-outflow-trade; I infer that expenditure can occupy the reseeding position in that chain. A live alternative limits the rain sequence to resurrection analogy and leaves spending economically rather than ecologically framed.

changed_reading.before: Giving is subtraction now compensated by a later reward.
changed_reading.after: Giving is the release phase of a regenerative cycle in which received provision becomes new life and differentiated yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: Good speech ascends in partnership with righteous action, while a rival program perishes. This couples the focus's recited wording to prayer and expenditure: utterance gains trajectory through enacted work rather than counting as an independent commodity.

activation_trace.role: One voice following another keeps the audible dimension of recitation active.
Rising with resolve supplies enacted commitment after utterance.
Comprehensible speech linking speakers supplies the verbal object that moves upward.
Wholesomeness opposed to corruption supplies the speech's qualifying quality.
Purposive action supplies the operative partner of the spoken word.
Lifting upward supplies the directional relation between word and deed.
The rival program's ruin supplies the downward counter-trajectory.

structural_cues: 35:10 places ascending good speech beside righteous action that raises it, with an ambiguous pronoun/agent relation, before contrasting a perishing scheme.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies word, action, elevation, and ruin; I infer that 35:29 expands this coupling into recitation, prayer, and spending. A live alternative takes God, rather than the action, as the raiser and weakens the direct causal arrow while preserving their association.

changed_reading.before: Recitation, prayer, and spending are three independently credited deeds.
changed_reading.after: Recited speech is carried upward through embodied prayer and expenditure; the three predicates form one word-action mechanism.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sea scene turns trade into movement toward a trading ground: a vessel cleaves resistant water to seek surplus bounty. The focus practices become navigation and cargo discipline, while non-perishing means a venture whose route remains productive across materially different seas.

activation_trace.role: A destination to which one travels for trade supplies the focus metaphor with geography.
A vessel moving in water supplies the venture's carrier.
Cleaving water in forward motion supplies the costly route-making action.
Active seeking supplies the venture's intentional search for return.
A gracious surplus gift supplies the bounty sought beyond principal.

structural_cues: 35:12 moves from two unequal seas to food, extracted ornament, ships, seeking bounty, and gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vessel, cleaving, seeking, and bounty; I infer a maritime logistics model for the focus trade. A live alternative treats the sea scene only as evidence of provision and not as a template for devotional practice.

changed_reading.before: The trade is an abstract ledger entry.
changed_reading.after: The trade is also a voyage: disciplined movement through unequal conditions in search of granted surplus.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human need and divine sufficiency prevent the trade from becoming a reciprocal bargain between equal owners. The burden and purification sequence then makes each account non-transferable: received capital can be released for benefit, but neither liability nor transformed selfhood can be outsourced.

activation_trace.role: An allotted gift anchors the trade in dependence rather than equal ownership.
Enrollment in a register supplies the image of a personally indexed account.
Need and lack of means supply the trader's actual starting balance.
Independence from need supplies the asymmetry on the provider's side.
A personally borne heavy load supplies non-transferable liability.
Carrying an entrusted burden reinforces the account's personal custody.
Growth supplies a return that occurs within the acting person.
The very self supplies the non-fungible beneficiary of purification.

structural_cues: 35:15 states human poverty and divine sufficiency; 35:18 denies burden transfer and twice returns purification to the self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies asymmetrical resources and individualized burden/growth; I infer a non-fungible account rather than a quid pro quo. A live alternative allows social effects of spending while limiting non-transferability only to culpability.

changed_reading.before: A donor gives value to obtain compensating value from God.
changed_reading.after: A dependent recipient circulates supplied value, while the resulting responsibility and self-transformation remain personally indexed and cannot be traded away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The luminous Book is followed by water producing differentiated colors and by knowledgeable awe immediately before the focus. This can broaden following the Book into tracking a legible disclosure across written revelation and materially differentiated creation, then converting recognition into prayer and spending.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence supplies the act of tracing linked disclosures.
Written discourse keeps the canonical textual referent fully active.
The earlier written Book supplies the explicit textual pole of the distributed reading.
Illumination supplies the Book's capacity to make relations visible.
Kinds differentiated by color supply a material field of readable distinctions.
Disclosure to a knower supplies recognition rather than mere visual variety.
Fear joined with awe supplies the affective conversion from knowledge into posture.

structural_cues: 35:25 names a luminous Book; 35:27-28 move through water, colored fruits, mountains, people, animals, knowledge, and awe directly into 35:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies textual luminosity followed by patterned material diversity and knowledgeable awe; I infer distributed legibility across both domains. A live alternative restricts 'the Book' in 35:29 to the revealed text and treats creation only as adjacent preparation.

changed_reading.before: The readers vocalize a bounded written object and then perform separate duties.
changed_reading.after: The readers track a luminous pattern through text and differentiated creation, and their prayer and spending are the embodied consequence of that recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah resolves the trade vocabulary as settlement: earned dues are completed without deficiency and then increased from surplus bounty. The focus's non-perishing claim protects principal, while the continuation adds gain beyond contractual equivalence.

activation_trace.role: Profit-seeking trade supplies the open account awaiting settlement.
Excluded ruin guarantees that the account reaches settlement intact.
Completion without deficiency supplies payment of the whole due.
Compensation for work supplies the account's earned component.
Growth beyond the existing amount supplies profit after full payment.
Gracious giving supplies surplus that is gift rather than debt.
Making a little show a sufficient effect supplies disproportionate appreciation of the input.

structural_cues: 35:30 begins with a purpose clause dependent on 35:29 and sequences full wages before added bounty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grammatical continuation, complete wages, and increase; I infer principal-plus-surplus settlement for the focus trade. A live alternative treats wage and bounty as overlapping descriptions rather than two stages.

changed_reading.before: The trade merely avoids loss.
changed_reading.after: The account is first settled in full and then receives non-contractual surplus, distinguishing preservation from profit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Book is confirmed and then transferred as inheritance to a selected but internally differentiated community. The focus practices can therefore be read as active deployment of inherited capital, not as a label automatically possessed by every heir; different responses to the same asset produce wronging, moderation, or precedence.

activation_trace.role: A fixed binding writing supplies the asset whose use has consequences.
Skill in finding gain supplies the differential use of a shared asset.
Making an earlier promise actual supplies continuity rather than replacement.
Knowledge or Book passing as inheritance supplies capital received without purchase.
Selection of a chosen group defines the inheriting population.
A middle course supplies one mode of deploying the inheritance.
Advancing ahead supplies the high-performing response to the same inherited Book.

structural_cues: 35:31 confirms the revealed Book; 35:32 inherits it to selected servants and immediately divides them into three responses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inherited Book plus differentiated heirs; I infer that 35:29 describes productive use of the inheritance. A live alternative identifies its practitioners specifically with 35:32's forerunners rather than treating them as a practice available across the inherited community.

changed_reading.before: Readers of the Book form a homogeneous meritorious class.
changed_reading.after: The Book is inherited capital within a heterogeneous community, and the focus predicates describe one productive way that capital differentiates its holders.

context_deltas.mechanism: The successful trade does not imply endless commercial motion. It culminates in being settled in a permanent dwelling where exertion and exhaustion no longer touch the residents; circulation reaches durable habitation without turning into stagnation or decay.

activation_trace.role: Active exchange supplies the journeying process that precedes settlement.
Stagnation that spoils value supplies the false kind of stopping explicitly denied.
Taking up residence supplies arrival rather than continued transaction.
Circulating states supply the process that resolves into the named dwelling.
Stable residence in a place supplies the destination's permanence.
Wearisome exertion supplies the labor removed at settlement.
Weakness and fatigue supply the depletion that no longer reaches the residents.

structural_cues: 35:33-35 move from entry and adornment to praise, removal of grief, permanent dwelling, and the negation of both toil and fatigue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trade followed by permanent residence without fatigue; I infer a process-to-rest transition. A live alternative treats the dwelling only as the trade's reward and does not contrast healthy completion with spoilage-producing stagnation.

changed_reading.before: A non-perishing trade compounds forever as activity.
changed_reading.after: The trade succeeds by reaching a permanent, non-depleting rest; cessation of toil is completion, not market ruin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later repeats increase but directs it into loss. This creates a counter-account: motion and compounding alone are not profit. The focus trade endures because its increase is qualitatively different from self-amplifying loss.

activation_trace.role: Profit-seeking exchange supplies the positive account under comparison.
Excluded market failure marks the focus account's protected direction.
Repeated growth supplies compounding that is directionally real but not beneficial.
Commercial loss supplies the explicit negative balance.

structural_cues: 35:39 repeats 'increase' twice, but the second increase terminates explicitly in commercial loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed accounting trajectories; I infer that direction and object of increase, not mere accumulation, distinguish the focus trade. A live alternative reads 35:39 only as punitive contrast without revising the mechanics of 35:29.

changed_reading.before: Any accumulation of credited acts resembles profit.
changed_reading.after: Compounding can deepen loss; the focus trade's durability depends on what circulates and where increase leads.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-perishing trade is not intrinsically indestructible. The same context attributes cosmic non-displacement to active holding; the account remains because it is upheld against removal, not because deeds possess autonomous permanence.

activation_trace.role: The negation of ruin supplies the durability claim requiring an agent or mechanism.
Active holding and confinement supply the preserving force.
Displacement from position or state supplies the failure actively prevented.
Continuance of a state supplies the positive persistence produced by that holding.

structural_cues: 35:41 repeats holding around the hypothetical displacement of heavens and earth and denies any replacement holder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cosmic hold-versus-displacement mechanism; I infer the same agency beneath the focus guarantee. A live alternative limits 35:41 to cosmology and treats the trade's non-perishing as a separate promise rather than an instance of upheld stability.

changed_reading.before: Proper deeds become inherently permanent assets.
changed_reading.after: The trade persists because it is actively upheld against displacement and ruin, preserving dependence even after the deed is done.

context_deltas.mechanism: An invariant course admits neither substitution nor diversion, yet reckoning can be deferred to a fixed term. The focus hope therefore holds together certainty of rule and uncertainty of timing: earnings remain on account during forbearance rather than requiring immediate worldly payout.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time supplies the waiting built into hope.
The open trade account supplies value that must survive until settlement.
A continuously running course supplies the governing rule.
One thing standing in place of another supplies the substitution explicitly denied.
Diversion from one condition to another supplies the rerouting explicitly denied.
Postponement to a later time supplies forbearance without cancellation.
A fixed terminal time supplies the account's due date.
Acquired gain supplies the earnings retained for eventual assessment.

structural_cues: 35:43 twice denies alteration of the governing course; 35:45 pairs human earnings with postponement to a named term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies invariant rule, earned acquisition, delay, and fixed term; I infer a durable deferred account. A live alternative separates the historical rule in 35:43 from the eschatological timing in 35:45 and does not combine them into one settlement system.

changed_reading.before: A successful trade should display prompt profit.
changed_reading.after: The trade can remain visibly unsettled because the rule is invariant while execution is deliberately deferred to a fixed maturity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the tunnel and concealed-exit branches inside the spending root rather than using them as a gloss for expenditure. It remains anchored in the focus's exact spending root and its immediate hidden/manifest polarity. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for routed outflow and transparency, not as an alternative lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Spending is immediately distributed across secret and open modes.

activation_trace.role: A tunnel with a through-exit supplies a channel in which release is passage rather than disappearance.
A visible entrance paired with a concealed outlet supplies the risk of asymmetric visibility.
Interior concealment supplies the hidden section of the route.
Public manifestation supplies the exposed section of the same route.

changed_reading.before: Money simply leaves the donor in either private or public view.
changed_reading.after: Spending can be imagined as a through-channel whose hidden and visible sections are both named, preventing outflow from becoming an uninspectable escape.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it couples a near-birth branch of hope with a branch in which testing determines whether an animal is pregnant, then imports the surah's pregnancy and fruit sequence. It remains anchored in the focus's hope, non-ruin, provision, and trade words and receives visible contextual reinforcement. Downstream prose should call it a gestational analogy for viable delayed yield, never translate the focus verbs as pregnancy terminology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Hope and the denial of failure directly frame a trade funded from provision.

activation_trace.role: A pregnancy nearing delivery supplies hope as an outcome approaching emergence.
Testing an animal's reproductive condition supplies viability-testing under the denial of failure.
Life-producing rain supplies the generative material invested.
An interior pregnancy or fruit-bearing load supplies hidden development.
Delivery of a carried load supplies eventual emergence from concealment.
Ripened fruit supplies the mature yield of the delayed process.

changed_reading.before: Hope waits for an externally credited return.
changed_reading.after: Hope carries a hidden but developing yield whose viability is tested and whose non-perishing becomes non-barrenness rather than instant payout.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates both mapped prayer roots through heat and fire-straightening imagery. It remains anchored in the exact prayer occurrence, its paired establishment root, and the surah's explicit heat contrast. Downstream prose should render it as an annealing analogy for disciplined straightening under pressure, not as an etymology or replacement meaning for prayer.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Establishing directly governs prayer inside the trade mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and balanced alignment supply the target shape produced by discipline.
Encounter with fire and heat supplies the testing medium.
Heating and straightening an object supplies the transformative action.
Heat opposed to cool shade supplies contextual pressure under which alignment matters.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is one credited item placed beside recitation and giving.
changed_reading.after: Prayer can be carried as repeated annealing that straightens the trader's conduct under heat, enabling the rest of the portfolio to hold its form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is unusual because it foregrounds the voice-following-voice branch of recitation and joins it to hidden sound and writing in revelation. It remains anchored in the focus's recitation, Book, and secret/public pair, with 35:31 explicitly reconnecting revelation to the Book. Downstream prose should qualify it as a transmission model, not reduce recitation to performance or claim that publicity is always preferable.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Reciting the Book precedes practices carried through both hidden and public channels.

activation_trace.role: A voice answering and following another supplies serial oral transmission.
Ordered written signs supply a durable substrate for the vocal relay.
Hidden communication supplies low-visibility transmission.
Public manifestation supplies socially distributed transmission.
A hidden sound supplies the concealed origin of the relay.
Writing and inscription supply conversion of the hidden communication into durable form.

changed_reading.before: Individuals read a fixed Book and separately give in private or public.
changed_reading.after: Hidden communication becomes writing, writing becomes voice after voice, and embodied public/private practice keeps the transmission from dying with one reader.

strongest_changes: Recitation became embodied following: the written and binding Book proceeds into maintained prayer and material outflow.
The trade became received-capital circulation with full deferred settlement plus surplus, not a bargain between equal owners.
Rain, renewed land, and fruit activated a regenerative reinvestment reading alongside the wage-and-ledger reading.
Book inheritance made the readers internally differentiable rather than an automatically homogeneous class.
The non-perishing venture ultimately resolves into permanent rest, while later loss and cosmic holding clarify both its opposite and its sustaining agency.
summary.what_was_special: The focus already contained an unusually dense market circuit, but context changed its direction several times: from opened provision to ecological yield, from audible word to action-raised speech, from inherited capital to differentiated use, and from active venture to non-depleting residence. Form-distant branches also preserved live tunnel, gestational, acoustic, and annealing analogies without forcing them into lexical claims.
remaining_uncertainties: In 35:10, whether righteous action directly raises the good word or God is the understood raiser changes the strength of the word-action causal arrow.
In 35:32, the focus practitioners may describe all productive heirs or specifically the forerunners; both mappings remain live.
The color-and-knowledge sequence may broaden the Book into distributed legibility, or may only prepare the affective setting for reading the revealed text.
The tunnel, gestational, acoustic, and heat-straightening models are branch-backed analogies and should not be rendered as replacement translations.
